error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: SEMOSS Code ran into an error it could not recover from. Reloading the page usually fixes it.

transcript.label: Transcript
transcript.firstRun: Type a prompt and press Enter to run the agent. Type :help to list commands and keys.

question.invalid: The agent asked a question this console cannot show. Dismiss it to let the run go on.

model.description: Choose which model to use for agent runs

harness.description: Select the agent harness type for this room

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.description: Controls randomness. Lower values are more focused and deterministic, higher values are more creative

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.label: Select Workspace
workspace.description: Connect this room to a workspace to inherit its MCP tools, prompts, and settings

mcp.title: MCP Tools
mcp.description: Configure Model Context Protocol tools for this room

agent.title: Agent Harnesses
agent.description: Select which agent harness to use for this room. Each harness provides different capabilities and behavior.
agent.noHarnessesDescription: Agent harnesses will appear here once configured. Check your system configuration.
agent.aboutDescription: Agent harnesses determine how the agent processes your requests and interacts with tools. Different harnesses may have different capabilities, memory management, and execution strategies.

mcp.title: MCP Tools
mcp.description: Manage Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools that extend the agent's capabilities. MCP tools can access external services, APIs, and data sources.
mcp.noToolsDescription: MCP tools will appear here once configured. Add tools to extend the agent's capabilities.
mcp.aboutDescription: Model Context Protocol (MCP) allows the agent to interact with external tools and services during execution.
mcp.knowledgeDescription: Connect to vector databases, document stores, and knowledge bases
mcp.toolboxDescription: Enable actions like web search, file operations, API calls
mcp.comingSoon: MCP tool configuration coming soon. Tools will be configurable per-room and workspace-inheritable.
mcp.noRoom: Send a message first to create this room, then reopen :mcp to attach tools to it.

transcript.droppedEvents: Earlier events were dropped from the live feed ({{n}}).
transcript.unknownItem: This item cannot be shown here ({{kind}}).

run.failedUnknown: Run failed. The server gave no reason.
run.lost: Lost contact with this run. It may still be running on the server.
run.approvalHint: Type :approve to allow it, or :deny to reject it.
run.approvalKeys: With the prompt empty, press {{approve}} to allow it, {{deny}} to reject it, {{edit}} to change its arguments, or {{always}} to always allow it.
run.awaitingAnswer: The agent is asking for your input.
run.subagentTooDeep: Its steps are not shown: subagents are followed to a depth of {{n}}.
run.subagentLimit: Its steps are not shown: subagents are followed at most {{n}} at a time.
run.parentEnded: The parent run has ended and will not use this subagent's result. Deciding lets the subagent carry on, and what it does is shown here.

session.busy: A run is in progress. Wait for it to finish, or type :stop.
session.noModel: No model is available. A model appears here once it is tagged text-generation.
session.unknownHarness: No harness named "{{name}}". Type :harness to list them.
session.unknownModel: No model named "{{name}}". Type :model to list them.
session.switchHarnessHint: Type :harness followed by a name to switch.
session.switchModelHint: Type :model followed by a name or an id to switch.
session.answerInForm: The agent asked a question. Answer it in the form, or type :deny to dismiss it.
session.editNotObject: The arguments must be a JSON object, in braces.
session.editGone: The call you were editing is no longer waiting. Nothing was sent.
session.alwaysAllowed: Approved {{tool}}. It runs without asking until you type :revoke, start a new room or reload.
session.autoApproveFailed: Could not approve {{tool}} automatically: {{message}}. It is waiting for you.
session.cannotAlwaysAllow: {{tool}} cannot be always allowed, so it is asked about every time.
session.revokeHint: Type :revoke followed by a name to be asked about it again, or :revoke alone for every tool.
session.revokedAll: Every tool will be asked about again.
session.unknownAllowed: No tool named "{{name}}" runs without asking. Type :allowed to list them.
session.saveFailed: Could not save the room settings: {{message}}
session.newRoom: New room. It is saved when you send the first prompt.
session.stoppedFollowing: Stopped following the unfinished subagents ({{n}}). They were not stopped on the server.

command.unknown: Unknown command :{{name}}. Type :help to list commands.
command.missingName: Type a command name after the colon, or :help to list commands.
command.harness: Show the harnesses, or switch to one
command.model: Show the models, or switch to one
command.clear: Clear the screen (the room keeps its history)
command.approve: Allow the tool call that is waiting
command.deny: Reject the tool call that is waiting
command.edit: Change the waiting call's arguments, then approve it
command.always: Approve the waiting call, and stop asking about its tool
command.allowed: List the tools that run without asking
command.revoke: Ask about a tool again, or every tool when none is named
command.diff: Show git diff for current changes
command.export: Save the last run's raw events as JSON

help.literalColon: To send a prompt that starts with a colon, type two colons.

key.approve: Approve the waiting tool call (prompt empty)
key.deny: Deny the waiting tool call (prompt empty)
key.edit: Edit the waiting call's arguments (prompt empty)
key.alwaysAllow: Approve it, and stop asking about its tool (prompt empty)

files.noRoomBody: The room's files appear here once you send a message.
files.filterPlaceholder: Filter files in the folders you have opened
files.hint: Open a folder to list it. Select a file to copy its path.

runs.heading: Run history ({{count}} total)
runs.emptyHint: Send a prompt to start your first run

cost.noteEstimate: Costs are estimates based on published rates and may not reflect actual billing.
cost.noteNoneRated: There is no published rate for the model this room used, so its cost is unknown, not zero.
cost.notePartial: The total counts only the models that have one, so the room cost at least this much.
